question: Should CodexBar permanently expose this local, identity-free multi-provider usage-card sharing surface from the status menu and Settings?
rationale: VISION.md reserves new product surfaces and privacy-affecting behavior for sign-off; implementation quality and runtime proof cannot decide whether sharing belongs in the product.

options.title: Approve local-only sharing
options.body: Keep the current no-upload, explicit-action, identity-free scope and merge after the test-fixture policy fix and green checks.

options.title: Narrow the entry points
options.body: Keep the export implementation but expose it only from the Usage & Spend pane or another owner-selected location.

options.title: Decline the surface
options.body: Close the PR while retaining the merged dashboard as the supported way to inspect aggregate usage.

recommendation.title: Approve local-only sharing
recommendation.body: Keep the current no-upload, explicit-action, identity-free scope and merge after the test-fixture policy fix and green checks.
